exposure: Doppler abnormalities (Umbilical Artery, Middle cerebral artery, cerebro-placental ratio)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 134 fetuses diagnosed with Intrauterine Growth Restriction (IUGR) via routine ultrasound between 2015 and 2021.
finding: Abnormal Doppler findings were significantly associated with lower gestational age, lower birth weight (mean 2052 grams), and increased NICU admission rates in IUGR fetuses.
mod_finding: Abnormal Doppler findings showed a significant association with the mode of delivery.
